title: Do Agentic Policies Need to Look at Every Step? Geometric Abstraction for Reasoning and Action
title_zh: 智能体策略需要关注每一步吗？面向推理与行动的几何抽象

paragraphs.en: Recent multimodal language models can reason directly about robot scenes, but it is unclear whether they need to repeatedly reinterpret raw visual observations at every step of an interaction. We propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through a 3D geometric abstraction that is refreshed locally from observations and read directly by the language models. Specifically, our interface represents scene geometry via typed, evidence-aware symbolic references to object parts, grounds them from calibrated RGB-D, and returns compact textual checkpoints with metric residuals after each action. Symbolic task structure can thus be reused across decisions while metric values are rebound to the current scene, with direct visual reasoning invoked only on demand. Across offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, reasoning over grounded text and symbols improves multi-step manipulation completion while substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries, positioning explicit geometric state as an effective substrate for agentic robot policies.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的多模态语言模型可以直接对机器人场景进行推理，但目前尚不清楚它们是否需要在交互的每一步都反复重新解读原始视觉观测。 我们提出通过一种从观测中局部刷新并由语言模型直接读取的三维几何抽象，将常规的空间推理从图像转移到文本与符号上。 具体而言，我们的接口通过带类型、有证据依据的符号引用来表示物体部件的场景几何，从标定后的 RGB-D 数据中将其接地，并在每次动作后返回带有度量残差的紧凑文本检查点。 这样，符号化的任务结构可以在多个决策间复用，而度量值则重新绑定到当前场景，仅在需要时才调用直接的视觉推理。 在离线策略合成与连续在线执行中，基于接地的文本与符号进行推理提升了多步操作的完成率，同时大幅减少了重复的多模态查询，这表明显式几何状态可作为智能体机器人策略的有效基础。

paragraphs.en: Keywords: Agentic Robotics, 3D Abstractions for Robotics, Spatial Reasoning

paragraphs.en: Recent frontier multimodal models have demonstrated increasingly strong 3D spatial reasoning and, in some cases, can directly drive robot manipulation without task-specific policy training [ 24 , 10 , 19 , 17 ] . However, deploying such models in closed-loop manipulation often requires repeatedly reinterpreting visual observations as the scene evolves, even though many manipulation decisions are governed by a compact set of task-relevant geometric quantities [ 14 , 26 ] . Repeatedly recovering these quantities from raw images introduces both reasoning uncertainty and additional computational cost: metric and structural relations remain challenging for vision-language models, whereas explicitly representing spatial information in text can improve reasoning reliability [ 21 , 15 , 18 , 23 ] . Moreover, visual tokens often carry redundancy, incurring unnecessary overhead during reasoning [ 2 ] . This raises a central question: does a robot agent need to reinterpret the visual scene at every decision step?
paragraphs.zh: 近期的前沿多模态模型已展现出越来越强的3D空间推理能力，并且在某些情况下可以直接驱动机器人操作而无需针对特定任务的策略训练 [ 24 , 10 , 19 , 17 ] 。 然而，在闭环操作中部署此类模型往往需要随着场景演化反复重新解读视觉观测，尽管许多操作决策仅由一组紧凑的与任务相关的几何量所决定 [ 14 , 26 ] 。 反复从原始图像中恢复这些几何量既带来推理的不确定性，也带来额外的计算开销：度量关系和结构关系对视觉-语言模型而言仍然具有挑战性，而以文本形式显式表示空间信息可以提高推理的可靠性 [ 21 , 15 , 18 , 23 ] 。 此外，视觉令牌常常带有冗余，在推理过程中造成不必要的开销 [ 2 ] 。 这引出了一个核心问题：智能体是否需要在每个决策步骤都重新解读视觉场景？

paragraphs.en: Existing interfaces trade off richness and compactness. Raw images retain detailed scene information but require repeated visual interpretation, while conventional perception APIs often expose only coarse object-level quantities such as centers or bounding boxes. ReKep [ 7 ] shows that explicit 3D keypoints and relational constraints can provide an effective interface for manipulation. Meanwhile, language-model-based robotics is moving toward persistent and structured policies: Code as Policies [ 12 ] synthesizes executable programs, ASPIRE [ 13 ] extends this paradigm through execution–diagnosis–repair and skill reuse, and Graph-as-Policy [ 1 ] represents policies as modular graphs. These works make the policy itself structured and reusable, raising a complementary question: what representation of the 3D physical scene should such policies reason over?
paragraphs.zh: 现有接口在丰富性与简洁性之间进行权衡。 原始图像保留了详细的场景信息，但需要反复进行视觉解读；而传统的感知 API 往往只暴露粗粒度的对象级量，例如中心点或边界框。 ReKep [ 7 ] 表明，显式的 3D 关键点和关系约束可以为操作任务提供一种有效的接口。 与此同时，基于语言模型的机器人学正朝着持久化、结构化的策略方向发展：Code as Policies [ 12 ] 合成可执行的程序，ASPIRE [ 13 ] 通过执行—诊断—修复和技能复用扩展了这一范式，而 Graph-as-Policy [ 1 ] 则将策略表示为模块化的图。 这些工作使策略本身变得结构化且可复用，也引出了一个互补的问题：这类策略应当基于何种 3D 物理场景表示进行推理？

paragraphs.en: To address this question, we propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through an explicit 3D geometric abstraction (Fig. 1 ). Rather than reducing objects to single 3D centroids or vague natural-language descriptions, our abstraction models scene geometry as a structured set of typed 3D object parts—including centers, vertices, edges, and oriented surfaces—annotated with timestamps and evidence status ( observed , inferred from shape priors, or unavailable under occlusion). Local perception grounds this 3D state from calibrated RGB-D and exposes it to the language model in two forms. First, symbolic references (e.g., red.bottom_face , blue.top_face ) and geometric operators (such as surface alignment and support checks) let policies compose actions independently of specific object coordinates. Second, compact textual checkpoints report updated 3D coordinates, metric goal residuals, and evidence status after each action. Separating reusable symbolic structure from scene-dependent metric grounding lets the language model reason directly in text and symbols, invoking visual reasoning on demand when richer scene context is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们提出通过一种显式的三维几何抽象，将常规的空间推理从图像转移到文本和符号上（图 1）。 我们的抽象并不把物体简化为单个三维质心或模糊的自然语言描述，而是将场景几何建模为一组结构化的带类型三维物体部件——包括中心、顶点、边和有向表面——并附带时间戳和证据状态（已观测、由形状先验推断，或因遮挡而不可用）。 局部感知基于标定的 RGB-D 数据建立这一三维状态，并以两种形式将其呈现给语言模型。 首先，符号引用（例如 red.bottom_face、blue.top_face）和几何算子（如平面对齐和支撑检查）让策略能够独立于具体物体坐标来组合动作。 其次，紧凑的文本检查点会在每个动作之后报告更新后的三维坐标、以米为单位的目标残差以及证据状态。 将可复用的符号结构与依赖场景的度量接地区分开，使语言模型能够直接在文本和符号中进行推理，并在需要更丰富场景上下文时按需调用视觉推理。

paragraphs.en: We study this textual and symbolic 3D interface in two regimes. In policy synthesis , the language model revises an executable policy between rollouts using execution feedback, while geometric grounding and control run locally during rollouts. In online execution , the agent repeatedly reasons and selects skills within a single continuing episode using the updated textual checkpoint after each action, without resetting the scene after failures. Both settings use matched sensors, actuators, and initial skills. Across both regimes, our experiments show that reasoning over grounded text and symbols accelerates policy acquisition, substantially improves multi-step online construction completion, and reduces repeated multimodal queries and interaction latency. We use these two settings to examine when explicit textual and symbolic 3D state is sufficient for manipulation and when direct visual reasoning remains necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两种情境下研究这种文本与符号化的三维界面。 在策略合成中，语言模型在两次 rollout 之间利用执行反馈修改可执行策略，而几何接地与控制在 rollout 期间于本地运行。 在在线执行中，智能体在单个连续回合内反复推理并选择技能，每次动作后使用更新后的文本检查点，失败后不重置场景。 两种设置使用相同的传感器、执行器和初始技能。 在这两种情境中，我们的实验表明，基于接地文本和符号的推理可加速策略获取，显著提高多步在线构建完成率，并减少重复的多模态查询和交互延迟。 我们利用这两种设置来考察显式的文本与符号化三维状态何时足以完成操作任务，以及何时仍需直接的视觉推理。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold: (i) we formulate a 3D geometric abstraction that exposes task-relevant scene geometry to language models as structured text and symbols—combining typed, evidence-aware part references with reusable symbolic structure and local metric grounding; (ii) we instantiate this abstraction as a reasoning-to-action interface with composable geometric operators, local RGB-D grounding, and compact textual checkpoints; and (iii) we empirically evaluate the interface across policy synthesis and continuous online execution, characterizing its impact on manipulation completion, model interaction cost, and the remaining role of direct visual input.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面：(i) 我们提出了一种 3D 几何抽象形式，将任务相关的场景几何以结构化文本和符号的形式暴露给语言模型——结合带类型的、有证据依据的部件引用、可复用的符号结构以及局部度量定位；(ii) 我们将这一抽象实例化为一个从推理到行动的接口，包含可组合的几何算子、局部 RGB-D 定位以及紧凑的文本检查点；(iii) 我们在策略合成与连续在线执行两类任务上对该接口进行了实证评估，刻画了其对操作完成率、模型交互成本以及直接视觉输入所剩作用的影响。

paragraphs.en: Prior work bridges high-level reasoning and low-level robot control through structured intermediate representations. VoxPoser [ 8 ] synthesizes composable 3D value maps for motion planning, ReKep [ 7 ] formulates manipulation as relational constraints over sparse 3D keypoints, and KALM [ 3 ] , RT-Affordance [ 14 ] , and ATK [ 26 ] extract task-driven keypoints or affordances to guide policy learning. Meanwhile, recent VLM evaluations show that recovering metric and structural 3D relations directly from images remains error-prone and token-intensive, whereas making spatial relations explicit in text improves reasoning reliability [ 21 , 15 , 18 , 23 , 2 ] . Rather than optimizing a single-step spatial objective or relying on coarse centroids, we maintain a persistent, evidence-aware 3D scene state of typed object parts (centers, vertices, edges, and oriented faces) that is continuously re-grounded from RGB-D and exposed to the language model as composable symbols and compact text.

sents.zh: 我们不再优化单步空间目标或依赖粗略的质心，而是维护一个持久的、基于证据感知的3D场景状态，其中包含带类型的物体部件（中心、顶点、边和有向面），该状态通过 RGB-D 持续重新对齐，并以可组合符号和紧凑文本的形式提供给语言模型使用。

paragraphs.en: Code as Policies [ 12 ] and Inner Monologue [ 9 ] pioneered composing perception-control APIs in code and incorporating closed-loop language feedback. Recent agentic frameworks extend this paradigm through coding-agent benchmarks and VLM module orchestration [ 5 , 16 ] , modular policy graphs and evolving skill libraries [ 1 , 4 ] , execution-driven repair in simulation and the real world [ 13 , 22 ] , and hierarchical VLA steering and failure correction [ 25 , 6 , 11 ] . While these works focus on how policies are synthesized, orchestrated, or repaired, we focus on the spatial state interface that closes the loop: re-grounding symbolic references after each action and returning metric goal residuals and evidence status in text so subsequent decisions reason over the observed post-action scene rather than assumed action outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: Code as Policies [12] 和 Inner Monologue [9] 开创了在代码中组合感知-控制 API 并引入闭环语言反馈的做法。 近期的智能体框架通过编码智能体基准测试与 VLM 模块编排 [5, 16]、模块化策略图与不断演化的技能库 [1, 4]、在仿真与现实世界中基于执行的修复 [13, 22]，以及分层 VLA 引导与失败纠正 [25, 6, 11] 来扩展这一范式。 这些工作聚焦于策略如何被合成、编排或修复，而我们聚焦于闭合该循环的空间状态接口：在每次动作之后重新锚定符号引用，并以文本形式返回度量化的目标残差与证据状态，使后续决策基于观测到的动作后场景而非假定的动作结果进行推理。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the geometric abstraction in simulation with an SO-100 robot arm equipped with calibrated side and wrist RGB-D cameras. paragraphs.en: In the policy synthesis regime, we test whether geometric abstraction helps an LLM acquire effective single-program policies within a small revision budget. The simulated SO-100 performs three manipulation tasks with randomized object poses and colors (Figure 3 ): Bridge+cylinder (placing two base blocks, spanning them with a beam, and placing an upright cylinder on top), Three-cube stacking (assembling a three-cube tower in a prescribed color order), and Ring-on-peg (grasping a hexagonal ring and threading it onto a vertical peg).
paragraphs.zh: 在策略合成机制中，我们测试几何抽象是否能帮助大语言模型（LLM）在较小的修订预算内获得有效的单程序策略。 仿真中的 SO-100 执行三项操作任务，物体位姿和颜色均为随机化（图 3）：桥+圆柱（放置两个基座方块，用一根横梁架于其上，并在顶部放置一个竖直圆柱体）、三立方体堆叠（按照规定的颜色顺序组装三立方体塔）以及套环上柱（抓取一个六边形圆环并将其套到一根竖直立柱上）。

sents.en: In the policy synthesis regime, we test whether geometric abstraction helps an LLM acquire effective single-program policies within a small revision budget.
sents.zh: 在策略合成机制中，我们测试几何抽象是否能帮助大语言模型（LLM）在较小的修订预算内获得有效的单程序策略。

sents.en: The simulated SO-100 performs three manipulation tasks with randomized object poses and colors (Figure 3 ): Bridge+cylinder (placing two base blocks, spanning them with a beam, and placing an upright cylinder on top), Three-cube stacking (assembling a three-cube tower in a prescribed color order), and Ring-on-peg (grasping a hexagonal ring and threading it onto a vertical peg).
sents.zh: 仿真中的 SO-100 执行三项操作任务，物体位姿和颜色均为随机化（图 3）：桥+圆柱（放置两个基座方块，用一根横梁架于其上，并在顶部放置一个竖直圆柱体）、三立方体堆叠（按照规定的颜色顺序组装三立方体塔）以及套环上柱（抓取一个六边形圆环并将其套到一根竖直立柱上）。

paragraphs.en: Pixel Reasoning and Geometric Abstraction share the task specification, calibrated RGB-D access, and action interface, both using gpt-6-astra with high reasoning effort. Pixel Reasoning implements custom perception routines directly in its generated program, whereas Geometric Abstraction additionally queries sensor-grounded 3D part references, geometric operators, and textual checkpoints. Neither condition has access to simulator ground-truth poses or private evaluator state.
paragraphs.zh: 像素推理与几何抽象共享任务规范、经校准的 RGB-D 访问接口和动作接口，二者均使用具有高推理强度的 gpt-6-astra。 像素推理直接在其生成的程序中实现自定义感知例程，而几何抽象还会查询基于传感器的三维部件参考、几何算子和文本检查点。 两种条件均无法访问模拟器的真值位姿或评估器的私有状态。

paragraphs.en: For each task, we run five paired training chains over five shared training layouts with separate persistent LLM contexts. Starting from an observation-only scaffold (R0), the LLM generates three policy revisions (R1–R3). Each revision executes across all five training layouts with a scene reset between rollouts and no LLM calls during execution; rollout outcomes and observations inform the subsequent revision. A candidate policy is retained only if it succeeds on every previously solved training layout plus at least one additional layout; otherwise, the incumbent policy is kept. After training freezes, each retained version is evaluated on 100 shared held-out layouts per task without further revision. Physical success requires achieving the target arrangement, releasing the object, and maintaining stability (Figure 4 ; Table 2 in Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，我们在五个共享的训练布局上运行五条配对的训练链，每条链拥有独立的持久 LLM 上下文。 从仅包含观测的脚手架（R0）开始，LLM 生成三次策略修订（R1–R3）。 每次修订在所有五个训练布局上执行，回放之间重置场景，执行过程中不调用 LLM；回放结果和观测为下一次修订提供依据。 候选策略只有在所有此前已解决的训练布局上成功，并且至少在一个新布局上成功时才会被保留；否则保留现有策略。 训练冻结后，每个保留版本在每个任务的 100 个共享留出布局上进行评估，不再进行修订。 物理成功要求实现目标摆放、释放物体并保持稳定（图 4；附录 A 中的表 2）。

paragraphs.en: Geometric abstraction substantially accelerates policy acquisition on both construction tasks. The largest gap appears at the first revision (R1), where Geometric Abstraction reaches 45.2 % 45.2\% held-out test SR on Bridge+cylinder (vs. 21.2 % 21.2\% for Pixel Reasoning) and 57.2 % 57.2\% on Three-cube stacking (vs. 17.2 % 17.2\% ). By R2, Geometric Abstraction’s mean test SR ( 63.4 % 63.4\% and 72.2 % 72.2\% ) already surpasses Pixel Reasoning’s final R3 performance ( 56.0 % 56.0\% and 70.8 % 70.8\% ) on both tasks, while expending roughly half the cumulative tokens ( 67.3 ​ k 67.3\text{k} vs. 125.7 ​ k 125.7\text{k} on Bridge+cylinder; 64.7 ​ k 64.7\text{k} vs. 138.1 ​ k 138.1\text{k} on Stacking). Although the gap narrows at R3 as Pixel Reasoning refines its perception code, Geometric Abstraction retains higher final success ( 65.4 % 65.4\% and 81.4 % 81.4\% ) and lower chain-to-chain variance, with comparable total tokens on Bridge+cylinder and lower token usage on Stacking. Ring-on-peg follows a different pattern: both conditions remain at 0.0 % 0.0\% retained test SR through R2, before Geometric Abstraction reaches 38.0 % 38.0\% at R3 while Pixel Reasoning remains at 0.0 % 0.0\% . Here, geometric abstraction enables successful policy acquisition within the three-revision budget where image-only synthesis fails to converge, as fine ring-to-peg alignment benefits directly from grounded part references. Note that these gains reflect the combined effect of policy synthesis and local geometric grounding during execution, rather than isolating LLM inference speed or text formatting alone.
paragraphs.zh: 几何抽象在两个构建任务上都显著加速了策略的习得。 最大差距出现在第一次修订（R1），此时几何抽象在 Bridge+cylinder 上的留出测试成功率达到 45.2 % 45.2\%（相比之下 Pixel Reasoning 为 21.2 % 21.2\%），在三立方体堆叠上达到 57.2 % 57.2\%（相比之下为 17.2 % 17.2\%）。 到 R2 时，几何抽象的平均测试成功率（63.4 % 63.4\% 和 72.2 % 72.2\%）在两个任务上已超过 Pixel Reasoning 在最终 R3 的表现（56.0 % 56.0\% 和 70.8 % 70.8\%），而其累计消耗的 token 约为一半（Bridge+cylinder 上为 67.3 ​ k 67.3\text{k} 对 125.7 ​ k 125.7\text{k}；堆叠任务上为 64.7 ​ k 64.7\text{k} 对 138.1 ​ k 138.1\text{k}）。 尽管 R3 时随着 Pixel Reasoning 改进其感知代码差距有所缩小，几何抽象仍保持更高的最终成功率（65.4 % 65.4\% 和 81.4 % 81.4\%）以及更低的链间方差，在 Bridge+cylinder 上总 token 消耗相当，在堆叠任务上 token 使用更低。 圆环套杆呈现出不同的模式：两个条件在 R2 之前保留测试成功率均为 0.0 % 0.0\%，随后几何抽象在 R3 达到 38.0 % 38.0\%，而 Pixel Reasoning 仍停留在 0.0 % 0.0\%。 在这里，几何抽象使得策略习得能够在三次修订预算内成功完成，而仅基于图像的合成无法收敛，因为精细的环杆对齐直接受益于有依据的部件引用。 需要注意的是，这些收益反映了策略合成与执行期间局部几何定位的共同作用，而非单独归因于 LLM 推理速度或文本格式化。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 50 paired layouts per task (300 episodes total) across three tasks: Bridge-tower (stacking two cubes atop a constructed bridge), Ring-on-peg (aligning and releasing a pre-lifted ring over a peg), and Tower relocation (transferring the upper two cubes of a column onto a new foundation while preserving order and foundation poses). Both conditions share identical local skills (bridge/stacking primitives, a shared sensor-driven ring grasp-and-lift prefix, and placement routines) and can request camera images and depth samples on demand; Geometric Abstraction additionally receives compact textual checkpoints and symbolic references after each action. Each episode runs continuously for up to 200 s with physics advancing during model waits (see Appendix B – C for full protocol and audited repeat details).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三项任务中评估每个任务 50 对配对布局（共计 300 个回合）：桥塔（在搭建好的桥上方堆叠两个立方体）、套环上柱（对齐预提升的圆环并将其释放套在立柱上）以及塔重定位（将一列立方体的上面两个转移到新的基座上，同时保持顺序和基座位姿不变）。 两种条件共享完全相同的局部技能（桥/堆叠基元、共享的基于传感器的圆环抓取与提升前缀，以及放置例程），并可以按需请求相机图像和深度采样；几何抽象（Geometric Abstraction）额外在每个动作之后接收紧凑的文本检查点和符号化引用。 每个回合连续运行最多 200 秒，物理仿真在模型等待期间持续推进（完整协议与经审计的重复细节见附录 B–C）。

paragraphs.en: Geometric Abstraction substantially increases completion rates on multi-step construction, solving Bridge-tower on 28/50 layouts (56% vs. 12/50, 24%) and Tower relocation on 42/50 layouts (84% vs. 15/50, 30%) with lower mean capped completion times (Figure 6 ; Table 3 in Appendix B ). On Ring-on-peg, where both conditions reliably succeed (50/50 vs. 49/50), Geometric Abstraction finishes 33.3% faster (77.2 s vs. 115.8 s), completing earlier on 45 of 50 pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 几何抽象大幅提高了多步构建任务的完成率：在桥塔任务上解决了 28/50 个布局（56% 对比 12/50，即 24%），在移塔任务上解决了 42/50 个布局（84% 对比 15/50，即 30%），并且平均限定完成时间更低（图 6；附录 B 中的表 3）。 在套环任务上，两种条件都能稳定成功（50/50 对比 49/50），几何抽象的完成速度快 33.3%（77.2 秒对比 115.8 秒），并且在 50 组对比中有 45 组更早完成。

paragraphs.en: Simultaneously, Geometric Abstraction reduces repeated multimodal querying (Figure 7 ). On Ring-on-peg, model-request time drops by 49.4% (45.6 s vs. 90.0 s), recorded tokens by 52.8% (101.3k vs. 214.5k), completed requests from 11.88 to 6.90, and attached images from 10.94 to 2.72. Tower relocation shows a 60.5% reduction in model time and 52.5% in tokens while physical execution time remains similar (104.5 s vs. 103.2 s). On Bridge-tower, Geometric Abstraction more than doubles completion with 6.7% less model time and 15.1% more tokens, showing that the interface improves performance both by cutting visual query overhead and by enabling effective corrective actions within the time budget. Across all tasks, local RGB-D sensing refreshes the 3D state while drastically reducing image attachments to the LLM (Table 3 ; Figure 8 ).

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation focuses on simulated table-top manipulation with regular object geometries. Real-world deployment remains an essential next step to assess robustness under realistic sensor noise, heavy occlusion, and camera calibration drift. We deliberately used lightweight CPU-based geometric estimators to keep local grounding fast and self-contained, leaving learned 3D perception modules and articulated or deformable objects for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估聚焦于具有规则物体几何形状的仿真桌面操作任务。 真实世界部署仍然是评估在真实传感器噪声、严重遮挡和相机标定漂移下鲁棒性的必要下一步。 我们有意使用了轻量级的基于CPU的几何估计器，以保持局部定位快速且自包含，将学习型3D感知模块以及铰接或可变形物体留待未来工作。

paragraphs.en: In continuous online execution, geometric abstraction reduced decision rounds and on-demand image attachments across tasks, indicating that its primary benefit lies in providing direct, actionable spatial state throughout the reasoning–action loop rather than merely compressing prompt length. More concise checkpoint schemas and learned symbolic abstractions could further reduce interaction overhead. For novel object categories, VLM-assisted shape initialization could broaden coverage, provided its one-time grounding cost is accounted for alongside policy execution and amortized across subsequent interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 在持续的在线执行中，几何抽象减少了决策轮数，并实现了跨任务的按需图像附加，这表明其主要优势在于在整个“推理—行动”循环中提供直接、可操作的空间状态，而不仅仅是压缩提示长度。 更简洁的检查点模式（schema）和习得的符号抽象可以进一步降低交互开销。 对于新颖的物体类别，VLM 辅助的形状初始化可以扩大覆盖范围，前提是将其一次性接地（grounding）成本纳入考虑，与策略执行成本一同摊销到后续的交互中。

paragraphs.en: Finally, decoupling local visual grounding from high-level policy reasoning opens the possibility of driving manipulation with fast text-only language models. By exposing verified, sensor-grounded 3D state in text, the interface allows a language model to reason over physical geometry without processing dense visual tokens at every step. Evaluating diverse models on standardized geometric checkpoints could clarify how effectively language models perform spatial reasoning when metric relations are made explicit, and help delineate which manipulation decisions are well served by structured geometric state versus direct visual inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，将局部视觉定位与高层策略推理解耦，为使用仅文本的快速语言模型驱动操作提供了可能。 通过在文本中呈现经验证且基于传感器的三维状态，该接口使语言模型能够在物理几何上进行推理，而无需在每一步处理密集的视觉标记。 在标准化的几何检查点上评估多种模型，可以厘清当度量关系被显式给出时语言模型执行空间推理的有效程度，并有助于划清哪些操作决策更适合由结构化几何状态提供服务，哪些更适合通过直接视觉观察来完成。

paragraphs.en: We investigated whether agentic robot policies need to reinterpret visual observations at every decision step. Across both offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, our results demonstrate that maintaining an explicit geometric abstraction improves manipulation completion while substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries. By pairing reusable symbolic references with metric values refreshed from local RGB-D observations, the interface allows visual sensing to remain continuously active in the control loop without requiring the language model to process images at every step—positioning structured geometric state as a practical substrate for agentic reasoning and action, with direct visual reasoning invoked on demand.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了智能体机器人策略是否需要在每个决策步骤都重新解读视觉观测。 在离线策略合成与连续在线执行两种场景中，我们的结果都表明，维护一个显式的几何抽象既能提升操作完成率，又能大幅减少重复的多模态查询。 通过将可复用的符号引用与从局部 RGB-D 观测刷新的度量值相结合，该接口使视觉感知能够在控制回路中保持持续活跃，而无需语言模型在每一步都处理图像——从而将结构化几何状态定位为智能体推理与行动的实用基础，并按需调用直接的视觉推理。

paragraphs.en: All experiments use MuJoCo 3.11.0 [ 20 ] with a simulated SO-100 robot arm. paragraphs.en: Symbolic references such as red.top_face resolve to typed geometric primitives: points, axes, or oriented faces with centers and outward normals. Each record stores world-frame coordinates, physical units, observation timestamps, and evidence status ( observed , inferred , or unavailable ). Initialized shape dimensions persist across an episode, whereas a movable object’s pose must be refreshed from current visual evidence after movement. For partially occluded rings, initialized boundary templates are registered to currently visible contour edges; underconstrained or ambiguous fits return unavailable . Unobserved object faces retain model-derived labels marked as inferred, while the stationary peg may retain an earlier verified measurement with its original timestamp. Geometric support predicates report metric residuals and missing evidence rather than certifying physical contact or dynamic stability.
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 red.top_face 之类的符号引用会解析为带类型的几何基元：点、轴，或带有中心和外法线的有向面。 每条记录都存储世界坐标系坐标、物理单位、观测时间戳以及证据状态（observed（已观测）、inferred（推断）或 unavailable（不可用））。 初始化后的形状尺寸在整个回合（episode）中保持不变，而可移动物体的位姿必须在移动后根据当前的视觉证据进行刷新。 对于部分遮挡的圆环，将初始化的边界模板配准到当前可见的轮廓边缘；约束不足或有歧义的拟合结果返回 unavailable（不可用）。 未被观测到的物体表面保留源自模型的标签并标记为 inferred（推断），而静止的销钉则可保留带有原始时间戳的、较早经过验证的测量结果。 几何支撑谓词报告度量残差和缺失证据，而不是确认物理接触或动态稳定性。

paragraphs.en: The Geometric Abstraction agent receives task-relevant object geometry, symbolic references, evidence metadata, and requested goal residuals formatted as structured text (with dense boundary point arrays omitted from online Ring-on-peg checkpoints for compactness). Multiple geometric queries can reuse a single RGB-D capture, and local sensing can refresh the geometric state after an action without attaching new images to the LLM prompt. In policy synthesis, generated programs invoke geometric operators locally during rollouts; in online execution, the agent reads updated textual checkpoints to select its next skill or recovery action.
